how_body: An owner is a customer with at least one paid order that included physical goods, counted once, by the country the order shipped to. For the United States we also count by state.

A country or state is published only when it has at least 5 owners, and then as a range (5-9, 10-24, 25-49, 50-99, 100-249, 250-499 or 500+), never an exact number. Smaller countries are pooled into Other countries, smaller US states into Other US states, and a pool is shown only when it too reaches 5.

The totals above are rounded down to the nearest 10. Every 30 days the shop recomputes the figures and keeps only that published result: orders and addresses are not stored for the map. The legal basis and your rights are in the [privacy policy](/privacy).
